name: validator1-nginx-isolation

base_results.finding: known green live reference with 12 ingress endpoints
current binary with corrected item-219 ports was correct but underdelivered, especially on validator-1 ingress
known-good binary did not reproduce with current environment; validator-1 ingress was the slow endpoint group
environment snapshot found nginx running only on validator-1 with 16 workers and listeners on 80/443

hypothesis: validator-1's extra nginx workload is a live environment delta that contributes to its slow ingress delivery. Stopping non-chain nginx before a clean item-219 topology replay should improve validator-1 endpoint delivery and recover green TPS if host-local CPU/process contention was the dominant current drift.

planned_commands.description: stop non-chain nginx through Ansible and print before/after service state
planned_commands.command: cd chain/deploy/ansible && KOMBAT_OPERATOR_TOKEN=$(grep -m1 '^KOMBAT_OPERATOR_TOKEN=' /tmp/and-live-testnet/validator-1.env | cut -d= -f2-) KOMBAT_NON_CHAIN_SERVICES_TO_STOP=nginx .venv/bin/ansible-playbook playbooks/stop_non_chain_services.yml

planned_commands.description: verify current binary and Mahi service config
wipe chain state and restart current chain services
planned_commands.command: KOMBAT_OPERATOR_TOKEN=$(grep -m1 '^KOMBAT_OPERATOR_TOKEN=' /tmp/and-live-testnet/validator-1.env | cut -d= -f2-) .venv/bin/ansible kombat_live_testnet -m shell -a 'systemctl stop kombat-chain-ingress3 kombat-chain-ingress2 kombat-chain-ingress kombat-chain && rm -rf /var/lib/and-chain && mkdir -p /var/lib/and-chain/snapshots && chown -R and-chain:and-chain /var/lib/and-chain && systemctl start kombat-chain && systemctl start kombat-chain-ingress kombat-chain-ingress2 kombat-chain-ingress3'

success_criteria.primary: state roots match at common height, request errors remain zero, Mahi pools drain after standard drain, and committed TPS approaches or beats the 85,382 TPS item-219 green reference
success_criteria.secondary: validator-1 ingress endpoint measured RPS moves materially closer to the other validators

rollback.service_restore: systemctl start nginx on validator-1 if the stopped service needs to be restored after the experiment

result.decision: Kept diagnostic. Stopping nginx is a valid chain-host isolation step and the run recovered materially versus item 249, but it did not restore item-219 green TPS. Validator-1 remained the weakest ingress host, and validator-4 also underdelivered; v2 and v3 hit the target band.
